name: com.kott.scopes
description: Hierarchical game-state management with scoped dependency injection for Unity. A scope bundles plain C# managers and an optional scene: managers get their contracts injected from the scope tree, initialize in dependency order before the scene activates, and unload depth-first.

samples.description: A small board game showing the scope tree, scoped dependency injection, both scene loaders, loading screens and failure handling. Requires Addressables and uGUI.
